examples.question_text:
(a) Find the perimeter of a rhombus with side length $8\text{ cm}$.
(b) Find the perimeter of a regular hexagon with side length $3\text{ cm}$.
examples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
(a) A rhombus has four equal sides. (b) A regular hexagon has six equal sides.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
(a) Each side is $8\text{ cm}$. (b) Each side is $3\text{ cm}$.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
(a) $P=4\times8=32\text{ cm}$. (b) $P=6\times3=18\text{ cm}$.

examples.question_text:
(a) Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length $9\text{ cm}$ and width $4\text{ cm}$.
(b) Find the perimeter of an isosceles triangle with base $6\text{ cm}$ and equal sides of $5\text{ cm}$.
examples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
(a) Opposite rectangle sides are equal. (b) The two sloping triangle sides are equal.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
(a) The sides are $9\text{ cm}$, $4\text{ cm}$, $9\text{ cm}$ and $4\text{ cm}$. (b) The sides are $6\text{ cm}$, $5\text{ cm}$ and $5\text{ cm}$.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
(a) $P=2\times9+2\times4=26\text{ cm}$. (b) $P=6+2\times5=16\text{ cm}$.

examples.question_text: Find the perimeter of a quadrilateral with side lengths $4\text{ m}$, $6\text{ m}$, $8\text{ m}$ and $5\text{ m}$.
examples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
All four outside lengths are given.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
There are no unlabelled outside lengths to find.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
$P=4+6+8+5=23\text{ m}$.

**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
Opposite sides of the parallelogram are equal.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
The outside lengths are $14\text{ cm}$, $9\text{ cm}$, $14\text{ cm}$ and $9\text{ cm}$. The internal height is not an outside edge.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
$P=2\times14+2\times9=46\text{ cm}$.

The matching marks show that all four outside sides are $8\text{ cm}$. The $6\text{ cm}$ diagonal is inside the shape, so leave it out.

$\begin{aligned}P&=4\times8\\&=32\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$
